label: broken

unstated.what: AppStoreValidator.__aenter__ must return self, so `async with validator as v` binds v to the validator instance and v.validate(...) works. The instruction's working example is `async with validator:` with no `as` clause and never mentions the context manager's return value.
unstated.quote: async with appstore_validator as v: assert v is appstore_validator

instruction_covers: The session is created only inside __aenter__, so validate/post_json outside the context manager hits a None session
Using the validator as an async context manager (async with validator) is the working usage
The reported failure is AttributeError on self._session.post
notes: Repo verified: inapppy/asyncio/appstore.py __aenter__ sets self._session = ClientSession() and returns None; __aexit__ closes and clears it. The session-init and session-close assertions are pre-existing behaviour preserved by any fix (R3), so they are not items. The only new checked behaviour is that __aenter__ returns self. The instruction frames a bug (session exists only inside the context manager) whose minimal fix is lazy session creation or a docs change to the example; neither makes __aenter__ return self, so the `as v` identity assertion fails the minimal-fix test and is not_inferable. No R2 sibling applies: this is the same method, not a named-but-unmentioned variant.
